Copy rule כ17 rules this exact class ('נוסח-הריק חייב לתאר את המסנן שקיים באמת בדף הזה') with the same substitution, 'בתקופה שנבחרה' ⇒ 'ללקוח שנבחר'. fixes.item: [6] loading/error with ?customer= on a surface that ignores the customer
fixes.what_changed: WHAT I CHOSE, and it is deliberately not the brief's literal form: while no payload has loaded for the active surface (scope == null) the header drops the SELECTED CUSTOMER'S NAME only — it does not drop the customer clause. 'כל הלקוחות' is a statement about the POPULATION, not about the filter, and it is true on all sixteen surfaces (a surface that ignores the filter does show all customers); a specific NAME is a statement about the filter, and that is the only claim that cannot be verified before the payload returns. Dropping the whole clause would also have undone round 1's item [27], whose measured error line is '12 חודשים · כל הלקוחות'. The selector stays ENABLED and carries no disabled reason (nothing is known yet — disabling a control out of doubt removes an ability for no reason). An error AFTER a successful load is untouched: surfaceScope survives a failed reload on the same rpc, so round 1's behaviour holds there exactly.
fixes.test_added: ReportsPage.test.jsx: 2 new cases — an RPC that never resolves with ?customer=414 (no name in the header, '12 חודשים' and 'כל הלקוחות' both present, selector enabled, no disabled reason) and the other half, that the name returns as soon as a payload arrives. The first case was proven to BITE: with the new condition forced to false the case fails (vt-bite.log, exit 1), then restored and re-verified green.

Same page after the abort is lifted: window_label '⁦17/09/2025–17/09/2026⁩', selector disabled with 'הדף הזה אינו מושפע ממסנן הלקוח' — round 1's behaviour, intact. assumed.what: When BOTH a customer and a period are filtered and the table empties, the CUSTOMER sentence wins.
